hero.titleLine1: The nervous system for your stack.
hero.subtitle: GCP, GitHub, and Sentry each tell part of the story. Nervum links cloud infrastructure, repositories, and errors into a living map—always current—so your team reacts with full context, not guesswork.

problem.title: Signals stuck in silos
problem.subtitle: When infrastructure, code, and errors live in separate tools, nobody feels the whole system. Incidents start half-blind—and stay slow until someone stitches the story together by hand.

before.title: GCP Console
before.text: VMs, databases, and Cloud Run each sit in another corner of the console. The cloud sends plenty of signals—none of them automatically meet your repo or your errors.

before.title: GitHub, on its own
before.text: Commits and deploys live here, but tying them to what is actually running—and who owns it—still means manual detective work for every incident.

before.title: Sentry, disconnected
before.text: An error spikes. Which service? Which team? Which commit? The alert is loud; the wiring to the rest of your system is not.

after.title: Your cloud, wired in
after.text: Browse Compute VMs, Cloud SQL, and Cloud Run—start, stop, and inspect—without losing the thread of what else changed in the same window.

after.title: Your repos, wired in
after.text: Commits, pull requests, and merges from every connected GitHub repository flow into the same activity stream as your runtime signals.

after.title: Your errors, wired in
after.text: Sentry alerts linked to services and owning teams. From signal to owner in one context—no scavenger hunt across consoles.

howItWorks.title: Integrate in minutes
howItWorks.subtitle: Connect once. Nervum keeps your map and feeds alive so everyone shares the same sense of the system.

connect.text: Link Google Cloud, GitHub, and Sentry via OAuth in under 3 minutes. No agents, no YAML, no SDK to install.

map.text: Nervum builds a living map of your environments—services, databases, repos, and team ownership—and keeps those signals linked as things change.

manage.text: Start VMs, review SQL backups, trace a Sentry error to its commit, and read deployment health. React from one coherent view of the stack.

features.title: One nervous system for your software
features.subtitle: Pull together what matters from GCP, GitHub, and Sentry—mapped, owned, and ready to act on.

environmentMaps.title: Environment Maps
environmentMaps.description: Visual, interactive graphs of your services, databases, and Cloud Run revisions—per environment, always current.

activityFeed.title: Unified Activity Feed
activityFeed.description: GitHub commits, PRs, Cloud Build deploys, and Sentry errors in one stream—code and runtime signals on the same timeline.

gcpManagement.title: GCP Management
gcpManagement.description: Browse and operate Compute VMs, Cloud SQL, and Cloud Run without opening the GCP Console. Start/stop, inspect, audit—right here.

teamOwnership.title: Team Ownership
teamOwnership.description: Assign teams to services and environments. Every engineer knows who owns what—no Slack archaeology required.

accessControl.title: Access Control
accessControl.description: Per-environment RBAC. Control who sees which infrastructure. No over-sharing, no under-sharing.

aiAssistant.title: AI Assistant
aiAssistant.description: Ask your stack questions in plain English. The built-in AI knows your environments, repos, and health status.

automation.title: Coordinated responses
automation.subtitle: From signal to action—the daily paths your team already runs, with context that stays attached.

incidentTriage.title: Incident Triage
incidentTriage.description: A Sentry error fires. Surface the service, owning team, and latest GitHub commit in the same thread of context—no tool-hopping to reconstruct the story.

deployVerification.title: Deploy Verification
deployVerification.description: A Cloud Build job finishes. Confirm which GitHub commit triggered it, which environment it hit, and whether the service is healthy—without losing the trail.

preReleaseAudit.title: Pre-Release Audit
preReleaseAudit.description: Before a release: verify Cloud SQL backups, check VM states, and confirm environment status—one read on system readiness.

who.title: For teams that need to feel the stack
who.subtitle: Whether you are a solo CTO or a fifty-engineer org, Nervum gives you one living view of cloud, code, errors, and ownership.

ctos.title: CTOs & Tech Leads
ctos.text: Stop treating incidents as a pile of disconnected alerts. Nervum maps infrastructure with ownership baked in, so you read system state—not noise.

founders.title: Early Founders
founders.text: You do not have a platform team yet. Nervum acts as the shared nervous system for GCP, GitHub, and Sentry from day one—same reflexes for everyone.

teams.title: Engineering Teams
teams.text: Onboard new developers in hours. Services, repos, and environments stay mapped and searchable—shared context beats tribal knowledge.

security.title: Enterprise-Grade Security
security.subtitle: Your system data is sensitive. We take security seriously.

socialProof.title: Trusted by engineering teams
socialProof.subtitle: Join teams using Nervum to read their stack clearly—and move faster with confidence.

testimonials.quote: Finally one place where signals meet: we see what connects to what, who owns it, and what changed last. It feels like the system can explain itself.
testimonials.author: Sarah Chen

testimonials.quote: Incidents land with full signal context before we context-switch. Our MTTR dropped about 60% because the story is already wired together.
testimonials.author: Michael Rodriguez

testimonials.quote: We needed a nervous system before we could hire platform. Nervum gives us that shared reflex—everyone reacts from the same map.
testimonials.author: Emma Thompson
